clue.text: Scornful response from soldier returning holding broken blade? On the contrary

indicators.note: holding says one piece grips another, here the blade gripping the soldier
this reverses the stated relationship, so the broken blade holds the soldier rather than the soldier holding the blade
a broken blade is smashed into pieces, so its letters are rearranged
returning means the word for soldier is read backwards

parts.note: GI is an American private soldier

explanation.surface: A soldier coming home with a shattered sword and a sneer, though the clue then insists it was the other way round.
explanation.walkthrough: The surface has the soldier holding the blade; 'On the contrary' flips that, so the rearranged blade ('broken') wraps the reversed soldier ('returning').
explanation.definitionFit: Said sarcastically, the phrase dismisses something as unimportant, a sneering retort.

clue.text: Slight suspicion of engineers in spa town

explanation.definitionFit: Literally beyond our sun's system, so situated outside the world we know.
